rows.en: I had just started up the hill when—

ghs.en: And, as I begin to walk the hills,

rows.jp: タイヤがキュッと地面を擦る音。
rows.en: A tire squealed against the pavement.

ghs.en: The screeching sound of a tire chafing the ground.

rows.en: I sprang aside with consummate grace.

rows.jp: 「ぷろぺらららららららららっ！！」
「にゃいーーーーーーーーーっ！？」
ワイヤーアクションばりに吹っ飛んだ。
rows.en: I went flying like a wire-work stuntman.

ghs.en: I am blown away as if I were in a wireworks scene.

rows.jp: 顔面から大地に突っ込むもなお勢いは失われず、シャチホコみたいな体勢で爆走し道路脇の樹木に激突した。
rows.en: I struck the earth face-first without losing an ounce of momentum, tore along with my body arched like one of the fish-tailed ornaments on a castle roof, and slammed into a roadside tree.

ghs.en: When the face is violently riposted into the ground the precious momentum is not lost, and with a pose similar to a Shachinoko I roaringly crash into the trees on the side of the road.
Taichi: "...why you be knowing Our name..."

rows.jp: 「あたしのこと、忘れちゃった？」

rows.en: Maybe I’d saved her life long ago.

ghs.en: long ago, she might have saved my life.

rows.jp: ありガチ。%N※ありガチ＝太一語。ありがち＋ガチンコの意。定番中の定番に真正面から挑む姿勢。
rows.en: Clicharge.%N*Clicharge: Taichi-ese. Cliché + charge—a head-on assault on the most overused trope imaginable.

ghs.en:
Shommon.
* Shommon = Taichian for Shoot (the Pro Wrestling and Sumo term) + Common. An upfront challenge posture that is standard among standards.

rows.jp: 「俺が許容できるのは、すこしふしぎレベルだぜ？　君が十年前に結婚を約束した幼なじみちゃんだとしてもだ」
rows.en: “‘Slightly fantastical’ is as far as I’ll go, okay? Even if you’re the childhood friend I promised to marry ten years ago.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Isn't what I would need to permit here be at a somewhat freaky level now? Even if we assume that you are a childhood friend who promised to marry me ten years ago!"

rows.jp: 固ゆで気取りで告げた。
rows.en: I delivered the line with my best hard-boiled affect.

ghs.en: So I proclaim with stiffly-simmered panache.

rows.jp: というか、明らかにヘンだろう。

ghs.en: Or should I say, very clearly weird.

rows.jp: だけど可愛かった（駄目人間）。
rows.en: But she was still cute. (I was hopeless.)

ghs.en: And yet she was cute (me = hopeless human).

rows.jp: 出会いのセクハラとしゃれ込みますか。
rows.en: Why not commemorate our first meeting with a little sexual harassment?

ghs.en: Shall I entertain her with a first-encounter sexual harassment?

rows.jp: だが……なんだ、この感覚は。
「まさかシリコン？　シリコンだとでも？」
rows.en: “Don’t tell me... silicone? Is that silicone?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "No way, silicone? It's silicone right?"
I'm just being made to fly here.
Nanaka: "Quick to bounce back aren't ya."

rows.jp: スカートを持ち上げた、挨拶ポーズがゆかしい。
rows.en: She lifted her skirt in a quaint little curtsy.

ghs.en: An admirably charming greeting pose complete with raising her skirt in a curtsy.

rows.jp: ……の馬鹿二人、という光景になった。

ghs.en: ...of two idiots, to name what the scene turned out to be.

rows.jp: 「……とにかく学校行くんで、歩こうか」
rows.en: “...Anyway, I’m headed to school. Shall we walk?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...anyway I'm going to school, so let's walk."
An uniform that I've never seen.

rows.jp: この近隣の学校じゃあないな。
rows.en: It wasn’t from any school around here.

ghs.en: It's very much not of the schools in this neighborhood.

rows.jp: 運動神経はいいようだった。
こちらが徒歩で低速なのに、よろけもせずに併走する。
rows.en: Though I was walking at a crawl, she rode alongside me without so much as a wobble.

ghs.en: I am in the low gear of walking, yet she keeps pace without staggering.

rows.jp: 見るからに、元気溌剌(はつらつ)幼なじみ美少女といった案配だ。
rows.en: Everything about her screamed bright, energetic childhood-friend heroine.

ghs.en: From the looks of it, a flavored mix of sprightly genki childhood friend bishoujo.

rows.jp: 毎朝起こしにきてくれたり。
rows.en: The sort who came to wake you every morning.

ghs.en: The kind that would come to wake you up every morning.

rows.jp: 「あんまり動揺してないのかな？」
rows.en: “You’re taking all this pretty well, aren’t you?”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "You don't really seem shaken now, are you?"

rows.jp: 「世界がこんなことになっちゃって」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "With the world having turned out like this."
Can't be expected not to be.
Taichi: "I just don't let it come out."

rows.jp: 「俺はね……人が少なければ少ないほど、本質的になっちゃうんだ」
rows.en: “See... the fewer people are around, the closer I get to my true nature.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Me, well... the less people there are, the more I become my true nature."

rows.jp: 「今はまだみんながいるって知ってるから、保たれてるけどね」
rows.en: “Knowing everyone is still here is the only thing holding me together for now.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because right now I'm taking that everybody's still there, I can preserve myself."

rows.jp: 「太一は、自分が嫌いなんだね」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "You hate yourself, Taichi, that's it."

rows.jp: 「……嫌いっていうわけじゃないけど……わからないな」
rows.en: “...I wouldn’t say I hate myself... I don’t know.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...hate, not really, but... I don't understand."

rows.jp: 「本当に、わからなくなる。些細なことに思えてきて」
rows.en: “I really do lose track of it all. Everything starts to feel trivial.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Or in truth, I don't understand anymore. I just keep thinking about trifling things."
Taichi: "...it's painful, but just a little."

rows.jp: 七香は悲しげな顔をした。
条件反射的におどけてみせる。
rows.en: I started clowning around on reflex.

ghs.en: I make display of buffoonery as a conditioned reflex.

rows.jp: 「女の子を泣かせる時は、セクハラでって決めてるんだ」
rows.en: “I made a rule: if I ever make a girl cry, it has to be through sexual harassment.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I resolved that if I make a girl cry, it has to be by sexual harassment."

rows.en: I wiped at the corner of her eye.
“You looked like you were about to.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But you were as if to cry."

rows.jp: 「セクハラでってのが最低だなぁ」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "And from sexual harassment, that's really disgusting."

ghs.assessment: The source narrates that he puffs out his chest. “Puff that chest with pride!” changes narration into a command addressed to someone else.

rows.jp: 「美しいものを愛でる気持ちで、Ｈな悪戯をするんだ」
rows.en: “I grope them out of the same impulse that makes us cherish beautiful things.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I employ sex pranks to express the feelings of love I have for what is beautiful."

rows.jp: 「だって個性は、それがどんなに定型であっても、その人だけのものだから」
rows.en: “Because no matter how conventional a person’s traits may be, they belong to that person alone.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because individual idiosyncrasies, however much they may be stereotyped, are something exclusive to one person."

rows.jp: 「人間らしいということだから」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because it's something I'd call human-like."

rows.jp: 「それに俺も、真剣な顔で人を愛でる資格なんてないしなー……」
rows.en: “Besides, I’m hardly qualified to admire anyone with a straight face...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And also, I don't really have the qualifications to express love to people with a serious face either..."

rows.jp: なんか語ってしまった。
rows.en: Somehow I’d ended up giving a speech.

ghs.en: Why did I even end up talking about.

rows.jp: 俺だって人間だから、ごくまれに脈絡なくガードがゆるむ時はある。
rows.en: Even I was human. Once in a blue moon, my guard dropped for no reason at all.

ghs.en: As I'm just human, there are very rare times when my guard slackens out of context.

rows.jp: 「その意見は、はじめて聞いたな」
rows.en: “I’ve never heard you say that before.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "First time I've heard that opinion out of you."

rows.jp: 「ほんとに前に会ったことがあるの？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "We seriously did have previous meetings?"

rows.en: A lonely look crossed her face.

ghs.en: A face that seems extraordinarily lonely.

rows.jp: 「ふふふ、白状しないとスカートをめくってやるぞ」
rows.en: “Heh heh heh. Confess, or I’ll flip up your skirt.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Heh heh heh, no confession equals skirt flipping ya know."

rows.jp: 「そしたら、またつっこんであげる」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Try it, and I'll riposte you again."

rows.en: “You like getting rammed, don’t you, Taichi?”

rows.jp: セクハラに動じない相手だ。

ghs.en: An opponent unflapped by sexual harassment.

rows.jp: 「動じない相手のスカートめくってもつまんない」
rows.en: “There’s no fun in flipping the skirt of someone who won’t react.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Unflappable opponents make for boring skirt flipping."

rows.jp: 「あーあ、表層的で空虚なダイアログを身上とする黒須太一様が、どうにもシリアスなことを話してしまったー」
rows.en: “Oh, great. The one and only Taichi Kurosu—sworn master of shallow, empty dialogue—has gone and said something serious.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh, ahhh, Kurosu Taichi-sama whose fortune is in superficial empty dialogue has ended up talking about something so veeery serious!"

rows.en: With that, I started walking again.

rows.jp: 声はずいぶん背後から聞こえた。
rows.en: Her voice came from far behind me.

ghs.en: The voice I heard from far behind.

rows.jp: ありえない距離だった。
三秒前まで併走していた七香だ。
rows.en: Nanaka had been beside me three seconds ago.

ghs.en: as Nanaka was traveling right beside but three seconds ago.

rows.jp: 二十メートル。一瞬で移動できる距離じゃない。
rows.en: Twenty meters. No one could cross that distance in an instant.

ghs.en: Twenty meters. That is not a distance that can be traversed in an instant.

rows.jp: 叫ぶ。悲痛な響き。胸を打つ。
rows.en: She shouted. Her voice was raw with anguish. It struck me to the heart.

ghs.en: She shouts. It reverberates with bitterness. It pounds the chest.

rows.jp: 今度こそ、七香は泣いていた。
rows.en: This time, Nanaka truly was crying.

ghs.en: This time, Nanaka was really crying.

rows.jp: 「それがいいことなのかどうか、あたしにはわからないけど！」
rows.en: “I don’t know whether it would be a good thing!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "I really don't know if it's the right thing to do, but!"

rows.jp: 「世界を、すべてを元に戻したいって望むとしたらっ……」
rows.en: “But if you want to put the world—everything—back the way it was...”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "If you wish to turn the world back to normal, then..."

rows.jp: 白い指先が俺をびっと指す。
rows.en: One white finger stabbed toward me.

ghs.en: A white fingertip shot out, pointed at me.

rows.jp: 合宿に行くときに使った山道がある。
rows.en: There was a mountain trail we’d used on the way to camp.

ghs.en: The mountain path that we used when going to the training camp is there.

rows.jp: ほとんど獣道だが、山頂に出るにははやい。
rows.en: It was scarcely more than an animal track, but it offered a quick route to the summit.

ghs.en: It's almost an animal trail, but it reaches the summit fast.

rows.jp: 何が祀られていたのか、わからない。
rows.en: I didn’t know what had been worshiped there.

ghs.en: What is enshrined there I don't know.

rows.jp: 古く、朽ちた、小さな祠だ。
rows.en: It was an ancient, rotting little shrine.

ghs.en: It's an ancient, forgotten, tiny little hokora.

rows.jp: かつて、まつろわぬ神を奉じていたかもしれないその場所に。
rows.en: Perhaps it had once been dedicated to a god that refused to submit.

ghs.en: Once, it might have been that the place was dedicated to some rogue god.

rows.en: No one went near it anymore.

rows.jp: そこに何があるんだろう。
些細な疑問を返すべく、七香に視線を戻す。
rows.en: I turned back to Nanaka with that minor question in my eyes.

ghs.en: With the intent of tossing this trifling doubt her way, my sight returns to Nanaka.

rows.jp: 彼女はいなくなっていた。

ghs.en: She was nowhere to be seen.

rows.jp: 蝉も鳴いてない、静かな新学期だった。
rows.en: The cicadas were silent. It was a quiet start to the new term.

ghs.en: It was a quiet new school term, when even the cicadas didn't cry.
